brief.topic: How Drever keeps one presentation story consistent across authoring, runtime, delivery, and review
brief.audience: Technical builders evaluating or contributing to Drever
brief.desiredChange: Understand the system as a chain of versioned, inspectable contracts rather than a package inventory

slides.title: One story. Every surface agrees.
slides.purpose: Frame the architecture as agreement from reviewed intent to every delivery surface.
evidence: Story, MDX, Deck IR, CompilePlan, artifact, and four surfaces

slides.title: First, decide what must never drift.
slides.purpose: Establish the shared semantic center before implementation detail.
evidence: Audience, speaker, document, and export share one coordinate

slides.title: Before source, the story earns approval.
slides.purpose: Show the human approval gate before design and authoring begin.

slides.title: Each boundary leaves evidence behind.
slides.purpose: Separate readable source, semantic data, resolved capability, and sealed output.

slides.title: Extensions transform content—not the deck contract.
slides.purpose: Explain the protected compilation pipeline and the boundaries extensions cannot cross.

slides.title: The browser directs. The agent owns the work.
slides.purpose: Show how Studio coordinates local agents without becoming a second source of truth.

slides.title: Design changes expression. Plugins change capability.
slides.purpose: Resolve extension ownership without duplicating the deck contract.
evidence: unchanged slide, Step, and note semantics

slides.title: One coordinate drives every surface.
slides.purpose: Let the audience manipulate a manifest-derived route and output file.

slides.title: One platform transaction commits it.
slides.purpose: Show how Navigation API, React, View Transitions, and synchronization remain atomic.

slides.title: One route loads one surface.
slides.purpose: Connect code splitting, portable static routes, and typed document metadata.

slides.title: Inspect every state—not one lucky frame.
slides.purpose: Show deterministic geometry, contrast, runtime, and transition evidence across exact states.
evidence: every exact Slide and Step state

slides.title: A broken slide cannot erase the last good deck.
slides.purpose: Show how an authored render failure stays isolated while a valid repair replaces the draft atomically.

slides.title: Prove each promise where it can break.
slides.purpose: Match unit, compiler, rendered, and outcome evidence to distinct risks.

slides.title: Agreement, by default.
slides.purpose: Resolve the opening graph and return the audience to the product.
